Help with desk cover at the skyport
The desk wrote this for guests
Companion Animal Travel Desk support

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways helps guests move through pet travel with less stress. This note is for travelers who need clear, friendly guidance before they reach the gate.

Bring your pet's travel papers, carrier, and any comfort items you plan to use on board. The senior coordinator reviews daily service choices, while the welcome team helps guests get ready for boarding and keeps the handoff smooth.

If you are traveling with a small dog or another approved companion, keep the crate tidy, secure, and easy to carry. <<FACT F068>> Staff may check that your carrier and your pet are ready for the trip, so it helps to arrive with everything organized.

If your pet feels anxious, speak calmly and keep movements slow. Water, familiar scents, and a steady routine can make the trip easier for many animals. When you wait near the desk, keep your leash short and watch for signs from the team.

For more help, speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk at the airport counter.
